text:
Next Thursday I'm moderating a panel on the question that never makes it onto the pilot slide: what breaks when an AI agent moves to production, and who gets paged when it does?

Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild. 6:30 pm at a co-working space in Chelsea. Free.

Joining me:

→ Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company
→ Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which sells evaluation software for AI agents
→ Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

A pilot gets forgiving users and a team watching closely. Production gets edge cases, real money, and alerts at 2 am. I want to hear what each of them has seen break, and who ended up owning the fix.

If you're shipping agents, or being asked to, come join us. RSVP link in the comments.
